admission.justification: Realized across dashboard/package.json, dashboard/tsconfig.{app,node,driver}.json, and the three allowlisted test files, preventing accidental imports of the temporary TypeScript 6 compiler-API alias outside those three tests or missing explicit Node ambient types under TypeScript 7.

applicability: Dashboard TypeScript project configs, package.json compiler dependencies, oxlint import restriction, and the three compiler-API test files.
conditions: typescript ^7.0.2 owns tsc -b, typecheck, and build; tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json, and tsconfig.driver.json explicitly declare types: ['node'].

Only dashboard/src/test/wireFixtureGuard.ts, fixtureOverrides.test.ts, and loadIndependence.test.ts may import typescript-compiler-api (npm:typescript@^6.0.3), enforced by eslint/no-restricted-imports in dashboard/.oxlintrc.json.
exclusions: TypeScript 7 programmatic APIs under typescript/unstable/* until they leave unstable/.
Standalone TypeScript packages outside dashboard/, which carry their own package.json and tsconfig.json.

evidence: Planted TS2344 break in dashboard/src/test/contract.test.ts:519 caught by tsc 7.0.2 -b; planted restricted import blocked by oxlint (exit 1); clean-copy npm run typecheck, npm run build, and vitest (99/99) pass

Planted TS2344 break in dashboard/src/test/contract.test.ts caught by tsc 7.0.2 -b; planted restricted import blocked by oxlint (exit 1); post-sync npm run typecheck, npm run build, and full npm test pass

statement: Dashboard type checking and builds run on TypeScript 7.0.2 with explicit types:['node'] in tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json, and tsconfig.driver.json (preserving BUG-L29 incremental .tsbuildinfo caches), while only the three JS compiler-API test files import the TypeScript 6.0.3 compatibility alias typescript-compiler-api enforced by oxlint no-restricted-imports.
title: Dashboard compiles on TypeScript 7 while isolating TS 6 compiler API
